title: RepoFabric Ingest Protocol - publish/update envelope v1.0
description: Request body for POST /api/v1/ingest/packages and PUT /api/v1/ingest/packages/{id}/versions/{ver}. The RepoFabric-custom envelope wraps an unmodified WinGet 1.6.0 manifest set. Binaries are pushed (installerUploads) for binaryMode=local, or referenced in the manifest for binaryMode=upstream.

repoId.description: Target existing managed repo slug; must be on the caller's allow-list.

binaryMode.description: local = push + self-host + rewrite InstallerUrl; upstream = reference InstallerUrl + verify InstallerSha256.

idempotencyKey.description: Client dedup key; same key + same body replays, different body is a 409 conflict.

clientId.description: Informational only; authoritative identity is the verified RFC 9421 signer keyid.

installerUploads.description: Present for binaryMode=local. Pointers returned by POST /api/v1/ingest/binaries. Absent/empty for upstream.

uploadId.description: Opaque id from the binary stage endpoint.

sha256.description: Client-declared hash; must match the staged file (hash-binding) or the publish is rejected 409.

override.description: DELETE only. Requests an audited deletion-gate override.
